correctness.rationale: Parseval and the pair-of-frequencies 2×2 Hermitian bound give a universal support upper bound. Opposite-frequency long finite blocks achieve every fiber Rayleigh quotient in the limit. Strict scalar concavity verifies the explicit threshold. Translation by the shift gives W inside W_e, hence closure equality, and uniqueness of the fiber maximizing frequency prevents every support value from being attained. Convexity from Kołaczek–Müller 2025 implies exactly the interior. The 390 finite checks confirm quadratic-form signs and approximate the formula, but do not prove the infinite-dimensional results.

value.rationale: A natural simplest nontrivial mixture of a unilateral linear shift and coordinate-conjugation has an all-parameter exact two-regime support function, an angular phase transition, proper circular and noncircular arcs, and a complete ordinary-versus-essential boundary-attainment classification. Neither constituent operator alone has this geometry; this is a structural example for the emerging general theory, not an arbitrary numerical constant.
